objective: Add a durable local, tamper-evident evidence registry keyed by exact candidate/artifact and required qualification claim with scenario records, while explicitly retaining independent custody and certification as external requirements.
nonGoals: No real publisher/CI/provider evidence creation or external operator attestation
No treating candidate-supplied evidence bytes and SHA as authenticated truth
No paid immutable store or production deployment/release
decisions: Use local single-host SQLite FULL/WAL, immutable event ID and SHA-256 chain over typed record metadata and bytes.
Verify local history before coverage; record positive and negative reference-case bytes without calling them authenticated or independently retained.

obligations.description: Atomic event append; exact replay permitted, conflicting event mutation rejected; detect changed stored bytes and hash chain.
Bind evidence to exact source commit and artifact and require each claim with both positive and negative case records; missing cases explicit.
Local chain/checksum is not independently authenticated immutable custody; prevent positive production acceptance

structure: src/sf/evidence_registry.py append-only local reference evidence journal
tests/test_evidence_registry.py tamper, replay, restart, scope, coverage
impact: New offline opt-in single-host local persistence; no changes to protected or previous production gates

budget.network: No external provider; GitHub PR only
budget.execution: Local SQLite tests and required once-only hosted check

externalEffects: Only isolated local fixture DB and stacked branch
